I've considered the Price of Victory... 

 

 

Done considering.  That was easy.

 

Mint.  Bit of a breather.  The start is vicious, but Blade simply doesn't have the damage output required to take down this team in the time it takes for them to take him down, and none of the real problem cards from Megalopolis ever show their faces.

posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
The start reminded me of how I once had a Prime Wardens game against Blade where in the middle of the game he dropped all 4 Hasten Dooms in a row and finished off with a Devious Disruption. Still won, but egads did that one hurt as everyone got a solid half their HP taken off in one go, not to mention 5 cards to the trash.

But yeah, this one might have been more hairy if it were Advanced. I won't complain about a nice softball now and then, though.
